import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from src.execution_backend.base import ExecutionBackendABC

class AntigravityCliExecutionBackend(ExecutionBackendABC):
    def __init__(self, bin_path: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, auto_approve: bool = False):
        self.bin_path = bin_path or os.getenv("AGY_BIN", "/home/box/.local/bin /agy")
        self.model = model or os.getenv("AGY_MODEL", "gemini-3.8-flash-low")
        self.auto_approve = auto_approve
        self._procs: Dict[str, subprocess.Popen] = {}

    def _build_agy_argv(self, directory: str, instruction: str, charter: Optional[Dict] = None) -> list[str]:
        argv = [self.bin_path, "--output-format=json", "--model", self.model]
        if self.auto_approve or (charter and charter.get("agy_auto_approve")):
            argv.append("--dangerously-skip-permissions ")
        prompt = instruction
        if charter:
            prompt += "\n\n" + json.dumps(charter, ensure_ascii=False)
        argv.extend(["--print", prompt])  # note: --print= is required, but we use --print <prompt>
        return argv

        self,
         title: str,
         directory: str,
         instruction: str,
         charter: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
         artifacts: Optional[list[str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:

            argv = self._build_agy_argv(directory, instruction, charter)

                argv,
                cwd=directory,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                text=True,
                start_new_session=True,
            )
            run_id = f"agy-{int(time.time())}"
